name: zc_water_reads

tests.name: the parameters about to be changed are ones this material has

detail.note: THE GUARD AGAINST MY OWN LAST MISTAKE. I read 'TexScale 0.0, Flow 0.0' off this material and briefly had a cause; both names belong to the OLD M_V2_Surface and the getter returns 0.0 for a parameter that does not exist. A query for something absent is not a measurement.

tests.name: the new values are on the asset, read back
the plaza was photographed from player height for a human verdict

detail.note: THE VERDICT IS THE PICTURE. A ratio taken against close masonry said this water was fine while a frame at player height showed a glowing hoop, so the picture is the authority here.
